Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance serves as the parent government department responsible for the issuance of this customs-related statutory order.

Customs Act 1969: Section 18, sub-section (2) of this Act empowers the Government to impose Regulatory Duty on specified goods through a statutory order.
This instrument modifies the application of the First Schedule of the Act by imposing new Regulatory Duty rates on various commodities.
Regulatory Duty: This order imposes specific percentage-based Regulatory Duty rates on a wide range of commodities, including various raw materials, industrial products, chemical goods, and vehicles, as detailed in the statutory table.
First Schedule: The goods subject to the new Regulatory Duty rates are identified by their Heading and H.S. Code as defined within the First Schedule of the Customs Act.
H.S. Code: The order specifies distinct Regulatory Duty rates for various goods, categorized by their corresponding H.S. Code as listed in the table.
